title: Measuring Violations of Positive Involvement in Voting
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures the frequency of violations of the Positive Involvement (PI) property in different voting methods.
findings: This paper contains no findings related to religion. Its findings relate to the conditions under which various voting methods violate the property of positive involvement, based on computer simulations with different probability models for voter preferences.
